name: Badge
summary: Passive status or metadata label with Info, Success, Warning, and Error variants and optional live-status semantics.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Inline non-interactive status or metadata label.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive badge state; visual meaning is selected through its variant.

behavior.name: passiveSemantics
behavior.description: Badge presents status or metadata and does not receive pointer or keyboard interaction.

behavior.name: liveStatus
attributes: role="status" only when content changes dynamically
behavior.description: Optional status semantics announce dynamic content changes without making every static badge a live region.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible text that communicates the badge meaning without relying on color.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Semantic color family for the passive status.

properties.name: announceChanges
properties.description: Adds live status semantics when the badge content changes dynamically.

accessibility: Use visible text that communicates the badge meaning; do not rely on color alone.
Keep Badge non-interactive. Use Button or Link for actions and Tag for a removable value.
Use role="status" only when badge content changes dynamically and should be announced.
Do not add a redundant aria-label when the visible text already communicates the complete status.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/primitives.css; Info is the default .badge style.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render product, order, inventory, or marketing badges with the same class contract.
